I have applied the implementation of `ShapeIndex.Encode` and `ShapeIndex.Decode` and am waiting for the `s2` test suite run to complete before adding unit tests for `ShapeIndex` serialization.
I have restored `Loop.IsEmpty()` in `s2/loop.go` and re-triggered the `s2` test suite.
I have added unit tests for `ShapeIndex` serialization in `s2/shapeindex_test.go` (all passing) and am now running the full repository test suite (`go test ./...`).
Added `Encode(w io.Writer) error` and `Decode(r io.Reader) error` on [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/shapeindex.go#L1649-L2300) in branch `shapeindex-serialization`.

### Summary of Changes
- **Serialization (`Encode` / `Decode`) in [s2/shapeindex.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/shapeindex.go)**:
  - [`ShapeIndex.Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/shapeindex.go#L1650-L1712) applies any pending updates via `maybeApplyUpdates()`, writes the header (`version`, `maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`), encodes all active `(shapeID, Shape)` entries in sorted ID order across all built-in `Shape` types (`*Polygon`, `*Polyline`, `*PointVector`, `*LaxPolyline`, `*LaxPolygon`, `*Loop`, `*LaxLoop`, `*edgeVectorShape`, plus a generic fallback), writes the full spatial cell index (`cells` and each `ShapeIndexCell`'s `clippedShape`s with `shapeID`, `containsCenter`, and `edges`), and appends a 4-byte IEEE CRC32 checksum.
  - [`ShapeIndex.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/shapeindex.go#L2110-L2300) validates all counts, bounds initial slice allocations to prevent OOM on truncated/malformed streams, validates cell/shape/edge invariants and CRC32 integrity, and marks the decoded index as `fresh` so queries and iteration work immediately without calling `Build()`.
- **Non-Contiguous Shape ID & Shape Method Fixes**:
  - Updated [`ShapeIndex.applyUpdatesInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/shapeindex.go#L838-L881) and [`ShapeIndex.makeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/shapeindex.go#L1241-L1246) to use `s.nextID` rather than `len(s.shapes)` so removed shape IDs do not cause higher shape IDs to be skipped or corrupted.
  - Updated [`CrossingEdgeQuery.candidatesEdgeMap`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/crossing_edge_query.go#L196-L206) when `len(shapes) == 1` to look up the remaining shape in `c.index.shapes` rather than assuming ID `0`.
  - Fixed [`PointVector.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/point_vector.go#L41-L43), [`LaxLoop.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/lax_loop.go#L74-L80), [`LaxPolygon.ChainPosition`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/lax_polygon.go#L206-L221), and decoder error/allocation handling in [s2/polyline.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/polyline.go), [s2/loop.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/loop.go), [s2/polygon.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/polygon.go), and [s2/pointcompression.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/pointcompression.go).
- **Tests in [s2/shapeindex_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-705i183b/s2/shapeindex_test.go#L577-L1170)**:
  - Added tests for empty indexes, all built-in shape types, unbuilt indexes, zero-edge (empty/full) shapes, mixed chain counts, non-contiguous shape IDs after removal, and malformed inputs (truncated streams at every byte offset, single-byte corruptions, and oversized allocation fields).
